title: Step-by-Step Corporate Incorporation in West Bengal via SPICe+ MCA Portal
summary: Navigating name reservation, digital signatures (DSC), DIN, and statutory post-incorporation filing mandates in West Bengal.
body:
Incorporating a Private Limited Company requires streamlined navigation through the MCA-21 portal via integrated Form SPICe+ (Part A and Part B).

Explore our comprehensive [company registration and MCA compliance](/services) packages or visit our [Kolkata Metro Chamber Desk](/locations/kolkata-metro) for corporate setup support.

Filing Form INC-20A (Commencement of Business) within 180 days is mandatory post-incorporation. Connect with our team to [schedule a consultation](/schedule) for complete statutory setup.
